items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: George Benson is a fine ah, ah, guitarist, man.

ctx.x: George Benson is a fine ah, ah, guitarist, man. And uh, and uh, I guess he didn't know he could sing either. (Laughter). Jazz, you know. And uh, I guess just to waste some time he should have been doing that years ago, you know. And I'm also uh, happy to see him ---- better but I could listen, ah to guitar players, I would you know, --

So do you--I'm not trying to lead you but I'm just trying to sort of put it into uh, a certain kind of thing of what I think I hear you say in terms of--you know, and it's still trying to tie it back to the whole thing of defining what is jazz. One of the things that you said, you mentioned about repetition and how they don't seem to have no imagination, you just keep repeating the same thing over and over again and how it doesn't seem to have any imagination--and you say why can't you come up with something…
